# disable_ton_wallet_backup_with_proof()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.disable_ton_wallet_backup_with_proof`

## Signature

```python
async def disable_ton_wallet_backup_with_proof(proof: 'types.TonWalletOwnershipProof') -> 'types.TonWalletState': ...
```

## Documentation

Disable the backup of the key of the TON wallet of the current user, proving the ownership of the wallet
instead of using the 2-step verification password.

Works only if [`TonWalletState`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletState.md) *is_backup_enabled* is True.

> [!WARNING]
> The backup is deleted from Telegram servers: if the secret phrase of the wallet isn't saved elsewhere,
> the funds of the wallet may become inaccessible.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`proof`** ([`TonWalletOwnershipProof`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletOwnershipProof.md))
  Proof of the ownership of the wallet. Use
  [`get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge`](get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge.md) to get a challenge for the proof.

### Returns

[`TonWalletState`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletState.md): On success, the new state of the wallet is returned.

### Example

```python
challenge = await app.get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge()
# sign the challenge with your own wallet code
proof = types.TonWalletOwnershipProof(public_key=public_key, timestamp=timestamp, signature=signature)
state = await app.disable_ton_wallet_backup_with_proof(proof)
```
